title: feat: editor panel settles on a critically damped spring

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: editor panel settles on a critically damped spring

description: Snap uses spring(dampingRatio 1, StiffnessMediumLow) so release velocity carries into the settle instead of a fixed 200 ms tween; release thresholds are 30% of the anchor distance and 300 dp/s (was 50% and 125 dp/s) so a short drag eases to the middle and a longer one closes. PanelBehavior.defaultOpenFor(w, h, rot) picks NORMAL for a portrait result and EXPANDED otherwise, first open only. The preview SurfaceView buffer is pinned (setFixedSize) while the panel animates and returns to layout size after. Device (Mi-Log 4K clip, 12 up/down drags per run): surfaceChanged 0 before and after (the surface keeps its size in this layout); gfxinfo janky 5.26% / 2.19% new vs 1.87% / 4.99% old, within run-to-run noise. JVM 2991/0, desktop 0.
